_comment: Model-fallback ladder (Tier 1) for gate auto-fix. Cheapest -> most capable. Each entry is a model string, or {"model":..,"host":..}; host defaults to studio (dense models won't fit the 12GB Unraid card). Edit freely -- read at requeue time, no code change needed. Env OLLAMA_DISPATCH_MODEL_LADDER (comma-separated) overrides this file. 2026-10-02: studio == Darkbloom, which serves ONLY qwen3.6-35b-a3b-vl-mtp-mxfp8 (+ the smaller Qwen3.5-9B) and aliases every ':'-tagged name to that default -- so the old qwen3.8/qwen3.6:35b/qwen3:32b/llama3.3:70b rungs were all the SAME model. gate-on-complete now skips rungs by SERVED model; the ladder lists only real distinct models. With one served model the ladder is honestly exhausted after the first model and the job escalates instead of re-running itself.
